name: WARLI ART
description: Ancient geometric tribal mural paintings using white rice pigment depicting circles of life, dances, and agrarian harvest rituals.

name: MADHUBANI
description: Distinctive folk art created with twigs, nibs, matchsticks, and natural dyes featuring mythological and natural motifs.

name: PHULKARI
description: Exquisite silk yarn embroidery ('flower work') on hand-spun cotton fabric reflecting the artistic soul of Punjab women.

name: BLUE POTTERY
description: Turquoise-glazed quartz pottery with Persian origins, crafted without clay and fired with delicate floral and geometric motifs.
